proofUses.reason: The bounded martingale coefficient justifies Girsanov on the whole finite height interval. The special parameter cancels the hyperbolic drift in either direction, and integration gives the derivative and physical-clock functionals.

Removing the terminal martingale density and changing variables from the Gaussian hyperbolic coordinate to the real endpoint gives every normalization and Jacobian factor. Gaussian integrability includes negative tilt parameters.

For imaginary starting points, dominated convergence against an integrable beta weight gives the exact Gamma constant and inverse square-root logarithm. The stopping time is a random height crossing, not a fixed physical time.
